# Claw Command Maid Standard Operating Procedure
Maids respond directly to the heads of staff. Their purpose is to serve, aid and assist the crew wherever possible, with the upkeep and comfort of command staff taking priority. In case their time is not requested by command they are encouraged to assist and help the crew while not staying too far away from command members. Maids are 2nd rank command roles. Maids should avoid doing security work, unlike Claw Command Officers. Though you can still be trusted weapons when things are get very dire. Maids follow the same SOP and escalation methods for violence, arrests and weapons as security does. Maids should seek to do service work when service does not have an abundant amount of workers, it is also not standard operation for Maids to wear security belts, this should only be needed in case of an understaffed security. Maids cannot become acting captain unless there is no other command onboard member, once such member arrives they have to hand over acting captain.
